description: University of Sheffield experiments used a full-scale drinking-water rig and sediment collected from UK and Dutch systems. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are laboratory observations from one study, not a representative operational network sample. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence.
